No lithography, etching, chemical processing, vacuum or semiconductor performance.

scenes.title: ETH multianvil laboratory inert-specimen access
scenes.reference_notes: A panoramic real workroom photo shows an orange rectangular gantry/press at left, a blue front-centre frame with yellow cylindrical ram, and a tall dark blue four-column press to the right. Green-topped wooden islands sit in the left aisle; computers are on a freestanding white table by the right press. Red overhead crane rails and services span the ceiling; a yellow rear cabinet stands near a porthole door and short dark steps. Panorama is photographic, not a measured floor plan. Visible press label does not validate performance. No pressure generation, heating, material transformation, force calibration or high-pressure operating sequence. Only mechanically supported inert specimen access.

A separate close-up shows a cable-connected probe on a metal carrier over a granular bed; its exact location relative to the overview is not established. No flowing water, sediment transport, cavitation, erosion, pump dynamics or hydraulic validation.
